events.text: The Air Staff was dissolved and ceased as a staff and authority.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 30 June 1994 , the Air Staff was dissolved and ceased as a staff and authority .

events.text: The Air Force Command (Flygvapenledningen) was formed in the newly established Swedish Armed Forces Headquarters.
events.subject: self
events.quote: on 1 July 1994 , the Air Force Command ( Flygvapenledningen ) was formed

events.text: The Air Tactical Center (Flygvapnets taktiska centrum) was formed in Linköping.
events.subject: self
events.quote: the Air Tactical Center ( Flygvapnets taktiska centrum ) in Linköping

events.text: The Air Force Tactical Center, along with the Air Force Command, was reorganized and formed the Air Force Center (Flygvapencentrum, FlygvapenC).
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 1 July 1998 , the Air Force Tactical Center , along with the Air Force Command , was reorganized and formed the Air Force Center

events.text: The Chief of Air Force Staff position was replaced by the Inspector General of the Air Force position.
events.subject: self
events.quote: the Chief of Air Force Staff position was replaced by the Inspector General of the Air Force position on 30 June 1998

events.text: The Air Force Center was disbanded as an independent staff.
events.subject: self
events.quote: the Air Force Center being disbanded as an independent staff

events.text: The Air Force Center came to operate as the Air Force Tactical Command (Flygvapnets taktiska kommando, FTK).
events.subject: self
events.quote: as of 1 July 2000 , came to operate as the Air Force Tactical Command

events.text: The Inspector General of the Air Force position was changed to Inspector of the Air Force.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 1 January 2003 , the position the Inspector General of the Air Force position was changed to Inspector of the Air Force .

events.text: The command was reorganized and received its current name, the Air Component Command (Flygvapnets taktiska stab, FTS).
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 1 April 2007 , the command was reorganized , and it received it current name was the Air Component Command

events.text: The Swedish Air Forces highest command was again re-located to Stockholm.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 2007 , the Swedish Air Forces highest command was again re-located to Stockholm .

events.text: There is once again a position like Chief of Air Force in the Swedish Armed Forces Headquarters Training & Procurement Staff.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Since 1 January 2014 , there is once again a position like Chief of Air Force

events.text: The Swedish Armed Forces proposed in its budget for 2019 to the Government a reorganization of the command structure.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In February 2018 , the Swedish Armed Forces proposed in its budget for 2019 to the Government a reorganization of the command structure .

events.text: The staffs were proposed to be formed.
events.subject: self
events.quote: The staffs were proposed to be formed on 1 January 2019
